body:
Research-only doc (no code, no measurements claimed).

**What:** three-part synthesis — (1) fruit fly ethology canon, (2) CS computational representations, (3) build ideation mapping fly circuits onto JEV + ATLAS + MicroMoth-quilt.

**Key findings:**
- The CX ring attractor already implements JEV-shaped ternary evidence evaluation: conflicting cues *shorten the belief vector* (circKF), 10s darkness holds = Abstain.
- MB plasticity is depression-only + active-synapse-only = online LDA (Lipshutz 2023) → principled KC layer over the ATLAS codebook.
- Novel JEV v2 proposal: split Abstain into HOLD vs CAST (grounded in odor-OFF casting, van Breugel & Dickinson 2014).

All claims tagged FOUND / INFERRED / NOT FOUND. 5 builds ranked with pre-registration templates. Honesty ledger closes the doc.
title: docs: FRUITFLY × JEV × MOTH deep-research synthesis
